original_judgment.rationale: Calls cli.main under stream isolation and packages captured output, exit status, and exceptions into Result.
Validates filesystem paths against existence, kind, and access requirements.
Builds ANSI style sequences around the text and optionally appends a reset.
Returns an object found in the context chain or constructs and stores one of the required type.
Handles text/binary output, optional newline, ANSI filtering, and explicit stream flushes.
Loops until yes/no/default input is accepted, then raises Abort for a false answer when requested.
Catches UsageError from value_proc, repeats input, and compares the confirmation response.
Maps normalized and case-folded choices back to the original choice objects.
Checks lower/upper bounds and delegates to _clamp when clamping is enabled.
Returns a closed bound unchanged or shifts an open integer bound by one.
Registers lazy-file close or stream close/flush callbacks through ctx.call_on_close.
Restores cwd in finally and calls rmtree only when temp_dir is None.
Retries get_command with token_normalize_func, then fails if resolution remains unsuccessful.
Calculates value depth, invokes the type's split_envvar_value, and batches values for nargs.
Splits the raw environment string using the parameter type's configured separator.
Detects missing/default values and calls prompt_for_value when prompting is required.
Runs the interactive input and conversion loop delegated to by Option.
Builds prompt arguments and delegates to termui.prompt for non-boolean options.
Formats the exception message and emits it to stderr using echo.
The runtime implementation catches ClickException, invokes show, and exits with its status.
Applies style to non-byte messages, then delegates to echo.
Constructs the ANSI-styled string supplied to the output layer.
Writes the styled content and handles stream/color behavior.
Checks the generated directory exists both inside and after isolated_filesystem, then explicitly removes it.
Invokes the option with lowercase apple and asserts output uses the declared Apple spelling.
Its parameter table includes IntRange clamping and open-bound adjustments; each case asserts the converted value.
Asserts a captured custom exception and exc_info, then checks propagation with catch_exceptions=False.
Creates or updates a RequestsCookieJar by iterating the input mapping and honoring overwrite.
Normalizes and validates a request URL and stores it on PreparedRequest.
This fixture builds httpbin endpoint URLs, not PreparedRequest URLs.
The call hook assigns the Basic authentication value to r.headers and returns the request.
Iterates registered prefixes and returns the first matching adapter, otherwise raises InvalidSchema.
Calls lstrip on the URL before parse_url and scheme/host checks.
Examines byte-order marks and null-byte patterns to infer UTF encodings.
Uses guess_json_utf on content when encoding is absent and decodes before JSON parsing.
Builds messages for 4xx/5xx statuses and raises HTTPError carrying the response.
Selects the nested generator and controls cached versus streamed content; the actual exception handlers belong to generate.
Catches ProtocolError, DecodeError, ReadTimeoutError and SSLError from raw.stream and translates them.
Returns a CaseInsensitiveDict containing these four default header fields.
Checks no_proxy host suffixes, IPv4/CIDR matches, and the platform proxy-bypass result.
Checks the saved body position and body headers before calling rewind_body.
Seeks to _body_position or raises UnrewindableBodyError when rewinding is unavailable.
Calls should_strip_auth and deletes the Authorization header when indicated.
Returns true when old and new hostnames differ, with additional scheme/port rules.
Supplies the bypass decision used by get_environ_proxies.
Returns an empty mapping for bypassed URLs, otherwise reads environment proxies.
When trust_env is enabled, obtains environment proxies and merges them with request/session settings.
Updates a session-derived mapping with request settings, then deletes all keys with None values.
Unpacks file tuples, reads file-like values, creates RequestField objects, and invokes multipart encoding.
Changes POST to GET when the response code is moved (301).
Sends a POST through a 301 redirect and asserts the final request method is GET.
Prepares a URL beginning with a space and checks its normalized value.
Asserts a successful redirected response, GET method, and a 301 response in history.
Passes a cookie mapping to a session GET and asserts the session cookie jar remains empty.
Sets Accept-Encoding to None on a Session and asserts it is absent after preparation.
